name: providers
description: Check which configured LLM providers answer. The action defaults to check, which pings every provider with a one-token request and reports ok/failed/skipped with latency; {"action": "check", "provider": "kimi-k3"} checks one; {"action": "list"} lists them (name, default_model, models[]) without spending tokens. GET /api/providers relays list.
llm_description: Check configured LLM providers. action: check (default, pings all, reports ok/failed/skipped+latency; provider? checks one) | list (static models, no tokens).
